_comment: The $RCLAW token that exists on Solana mainnet. ONE record: the website
(bot/token/record.py -> /rclaw) both read this file, so no surface can
name a second mint. Every value was read back from the chain and the
Jupiter token index on verified_at (see basis). Re-read before editing.
token.config.json beside this file is the DEVNET DRAFT the tooling in
token/ runs against; it is not this token.
name: RUNECLAW Token

basis.mint, token_program, decimals, supply_ba: getAccountInfo(mint, jsonParsed) on api.mainnet-beta.solana.com: owner TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA, supply 1000000000000000000, both authorities null
basis.created_at: blockTime of the only signature getSignaturesForAddress(mint) returns (slot 452023656)

presale._comment: ANNOUNCED: the terms of the Smithii sale, written the way the website and the bot print them. Each is derived from token/presale/smithii.config.json (smithii_lib.mjs, recordTerms) and token/presale/the_record_states_the_sale.test.mjs fails when they differ, so change the config first and copy what the test prints. null is NOT ANNOUNCED (for sale_url: the sale is not created yet), and every reader says so in words; never fill a field with a placeholder. sale_url is set after Create: an https link on smithii.io, the only kind the website and the bot will show (tests/fixtures/sale_url_cases.json). opens_at and closes_at are the sale window Create fixed on chain (smithii_lib.mjs, recordWindow): they are not printed as terms; the website and the bot read them with the clock to say announced, live or ended (tests/fixtures/presale_phase_cases.json drives both). After editing, run node app/scripts/sync_content.js.
presale.date: 15 Oct → 29 Oct 2026, or until the hard cap
presale.hard_cap: 5,000 SOL (soft cap 1,000 SOL: a target, not enforced)
presale.claim: 100% when the sale ends. No vesting for buyers
presale.after_sale: The team creates the pool at the sale price with 80% of the SOL raised and burns the LP. The sale contract does not do this.

locks._comment: CREATED: the time locks of docs/TOKEN_ROADMAP.md section 4, made in Smithii Token Vesting, written the way the website (/token) and the bot (/rclaw) print them. bucket, tokens, schedule, unlocks and certificate_url are derived from token/presale/locks.plan.json (locks_lib.mjs, recordLocks); vesting_account and claim_wallet are what creating the lock decided. token/presale/the_record_states_the_locks.test.mjs holds every field to the plan and to a snapshot of the chain that npm run presale:locks-verify took; a lock not created yet has null in its three created fields, which every reader prints as not created yet. After editing, run node app/scripts/sync_content.js.

items.schedule: 5 unlocks (5%, 20%, 25%, 25%, 25%): at TGE, then every 9 months (the last at month 36)
12-month cliff, then 4 unlocks of 25% every 6 months (the last at month 36)
6-month cliff, then 3 unlocks (33%, 33%, 34%) every 6 months (the last at month 24)

multisig._comment: CREATED 2026-10-14: the Squads v4 multisig that holds the treasury, the partnerships bucket and the rest of the reserve (docs/TOKEN_ROADMAP.md section 4), written the way the website (/token) and the bot (/rclaw) print it. account is the multisig; vault is its vault #vault_index, the only address that holds its tokens (a transfer to account itself is lost). threshold, members and time_lock_seconds are what the multisig enforces; holds_tokens is the vault's RCLAW on verified_at, and buckets split it as section 4 earmarks it: treasury and partnerships whole, the reserve the remainder after the 100,001,701 that went to the pool wallet with the presale and DEX liquidity. token/presale/the_record_states_the_multisig.test.mjs holds every field to a snapshot `npm run presale:multisig-verify -- --snapshot` took. After any transfer into or out of the vault, re-take the snapshot and re-record holds_tokens and buckets. After editing, run node app/scripts/sync_content.js.

smithii_audits._comment: Audits Smithii commissioned of its own programs, as Smithii links them (operator, 2026-10-14), read on that date: auditor, what was audited, when, and when the auditor reviewed the fixes. They audit Smithii's code, not RUNECLAW. program is the mainnet program the audit covers where the report names it (null where the report was not read); final_report is the date of the auditor's final report, after the fixes (Halborn: last updated; CoinFabrik: the fix review; null where not read). Both programs are upgradeable and each was last deployed before its latest audit's final report (smithii.config.json program.lastDeployedAt, locks.plan.json tool.programLastDeployed), which the website says beside these links; token/presale/the_record_names_smithii_audits.test.mjs holds that sentence to those dates. Halborn's two fixed findings (multi-recipient Merkle vesting splits, zero-amount locks) concern features RUNECLAW's locks do not use. After editing, run node app/scripts/sync_content.js.
